name: Dr. J. M. Louthan
bio: Dr. J. M. Louthan was a Spearfish physician who in April 1884 rode with Jones, Jorgens and Deffebach over the new Medora freight route from the Black Hills in three and a half days and wrote an account of the trip for the Cow Boy. He gave the paper's Bad Lands museum petrified specimens and a sample of hard coal from a mine on the route, and in May 1884 he and Jorgens announced plans to settle in Medora and go into business, though the paper soon doubted he would come for a while. In July 1884 he guided the editor around Spearfish on a Black Hills trip, and he was quoted in a January 1885 Dakota Register item on an injury.
